about_the_game:
Reposition Defense is a tactical top-down Tower Defense, where you don’t just place your troops—you actively control their positioning!

The kingdom has fallen under the onslaught of dark forces, and its defenders have been bound by a powerful curse. They cannot move, yet they can still fight! The only one unaffected by the magic is the hero. Now, only he can reposition the army, moving swordsmen, archers, and other warriors to fend off waves of enemies.

Use strategy, adapt to new threats, purchase resources, and upgrade your army to become the kingdom’s last hope!

Key Features:

  • Tactical Freedom – Move units during battle and adjust your strategy on the fly.

  • Variety of Troops – Deploy swordsmen, archers, and other unique classes, each with their own strengths.

  • Item Purchases – Buy logs, bombs, and other tactical resources to strengthen your defenses.

  • Army Upgrades – Increase the size of your squads and improve each warrior’s abilities.

  • Dynamic Defense – Enemies attack in different ways, forcing you to constantly rethink your tactics.

  • Unique Setting – A medieval fantasy world filled with dark magic and cursed warriors.

  • Increasing Challenge – The further you go, the tougher the battles and the stronger your enemies!

Are you ready to take on the role of the kingdom’s last strategist and fight back against the forces of darkness?
